import hashlib,json,os,subprocess,sys,threading,time
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/user/src/work-leaf/bench-results/efficiency-measurement-gate-20260906/handoff_probe.py')
assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='eaa8257ab896f873b8c14f3c3ededa56b830da0aac82177aca2d0d22c6b02dda'
sys.path.insert(0,str(p.parent))
import handoff_probe as base
repo='/tmp/wl-integration-source-qual.zZiHof/author-joint-integration-004'
provider='/home/user/src/work-leaf/bench-results/efficiency-mechanism-isolation-20260906T214448Z/phases/standalone-global-hunk-pilot-01/infrastructure/provider/codex'
view='/home/user/src/work-leaf/bench-results/efficiency-mechanism-isolation-20260906T214448Z/screens/author-feedback-20260914/full-workflow-009/REFERENCE-PLAN.json'
bootstrap="import json,os,sys;sys.path.insert(0,"+repr('/home/user/src/work-leaf/bench-results/efficiency-mechanism-isolation-20260906T214448Z/screens/author-feedback-20260914/P01')+");import private_catalog;private_catalog.enter_view(json.load(open("+repr(view)+"))['profiles']['short']['view']);os.execv(sys.argv[1],sys.argv[1:])"
override='projects={'+json.dumps(repo)+'={trust_level="trusted"}}'
probe=base.Probe(provider,repo)
probe.deadline=time.monotonic()+15
env=base.child_environment(os.environ);env['WORK_LEAF_P01_PARENT_MNT']=str(os.stat('/proc/self/ns/mnt').st_ino)
argv=['unshare','--user','--map-current-user','--keep-caps','--mount','--propagation','private','/usr/bin/python3','-c',bootstrap,provider,'-c',override,'--cd',repo,'--sandbox','danger-full-access','--ask-for-approval','never','app-server','--listen','stdio://']
result={'scope':'read-only effective configuration, no thread/start or turn/start','argv':argv}
try:
    probe.process=subprocess.Popen(argv,cwd=repo,env=env,stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True,start_new_session=True)
    for reader in (probe.read_stdout,probe.read_stderr):
        t=threading.Thread(target=reader,daemon=True);t.start();probe.readers.append(t)
    probe.request('init','initialize',{'clientInfo':{'name':'work_leaf_config_probe','version':'1'},'capabilities':{'experimentalApi':True}})
    probe.send({'method':'initialized'})
    response=probe.request('config','config/read',{'includeLayers':True,'cwd':repo})
    result['response_keys']=list(response)
    cfg=response.get('config',{})
    result['project_key_candidates']=[k for k in cfg.get('projects',{}) if 'wl-full-route-verify' in k]
    result['target_project']=cfg.get('projects',{}).get(repo)
    import tomllib
    old=tomllib.loads(Path('/tmp/work-leaf-p01-cache-view.Xc6Oc6/config-short-keep-plugins.toml').read_text())['projects']
    expected={**old,repo:{'trust_level':'trusted'}}
    result['all_projects_match_expected']=cfg.get('projects')==expected
    result['existing_project_count']=len(old)
    assert cfg.get('projects')==expected, 'trust repair changes other project states'
    result['session_flag_projects']=[x.get('config',{}).get('projects') for x in response.get('layers',[]) if x.get('name',{}).get('type')=='sessionFlags']
except Exception as error:
    result['error']=type(error).__name__+': '+str(error)
finally:
    probe.cleanup()
result['trace']=probe.evidence['trace']
result['model_turns_requested']=probe.evidence['model_turns_requested']
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
